verdict.rationale: Training-data opt-out is a fair privacy question for an agent with a managed cloud service, so the axis applies. The pack contains no documented training opt-out, no no-training policy, and no data-usage control. Local running, self-hosting, and bring-your-own LLM keys are adjacent deployment options, not a documented guarantee that user data is excluded from model training.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
